meta.sourceBoundary: Owned-build configuration plus existing public observations; not a current-runtime transcript.
meta.nodeContract: Nodes and edges retain conversation/entry IDs. Conditions are summarized as availability notes and are never evaluated by the site.

scenes.title: Arrival and the first hand-off
scenes.summary: The retained quest conversation moves from Meriam's airport greeting to taking the wheel, then records the welcome pack and the hand-off toward City Hall.
scenes.zhSummary: 保留的任务对话从玛丽阿姆在机场打招呼开始，经过接过方向盘，再到欢迎礼包和前往市政厅的交接。
scenes.spoiler: This is an editor-selected path through the recorded nodes. It does not guarantee current runtime order or every trigger.
scenes.zhSpoiler: 这是从已记录节点中选出的查阅路径，不保证当前运行顺序或全部触发条件。

groups.label: Airport greeting to the ranch hand-off
groups.zhLabel: 从机场问候到牧场交接
groups.overview: A real node path in Conversation 52: greeting, driving hand-off and departure.
groups.zhOverview: 对话 52 中的实际节点路径：问候、驾驶交接和出发。

nodes.speaker: Meriam
nodes.text: Hey there, {PLAYER_NAME}! I’m Meriam! Welcome to Ranchers Country! I’m so glad you made it safely. How was your flight?
nodes.zhText: 嘿，{PLAYER_NAME}！我是玛丽阿姆！欢迎来到牧场之乡！你安全到了，我太开心了。飞行过程怎么样？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was good, thanks!
nodes.zhText: 还不错，谢谢！

nodes.speaker: Meriam
nodes.text: Perfect! Would you mind taking the wheel? I’ve got your ride warmed up right over there.
nodes.zhText: 太好了！你愿意来开车吗？我已经把你的车预热好了，就在那边。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure thing!
nodes.zhText: 当然可以！

nodes.speaker: Meriam
nodes.text: Okay, go ahead to the car, I’ll follow. Your ranch is ready.
nodes.zhText: 好的，你先去车上，我跟在后面。你的牧场已经准备好了。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's go!
nodes.zhText: 走吧！

groups.label: Welcome pack and Victor hand-off
groups.zhLabel: 欢迎礼包与维克多交接
groups.overview: A later recorded segment lists the hammer, Red Tent blueprint and strawberries before pointing to Mayor Victor.
groups.zhOverview: 后续已记录片段列出锤子、红色帐篷蓝图和草莓，然后把玩家引向维克多市长。

nodes.speaker: Meriam
nodes.text: First, this hammer. Next, here’s the blueprint for a simple tent. And lastly… strawberries!
nodes.zhText: 首先是这把锤子。然后是简易帐篷的蓝图。最后……是草莓！

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you, Meriam!
nodes.zhText: 谢谢你，玛丽阿姆！

nodes.speaker: Meriam
nodes.text: I need to dash over to the city hall and tell Mayor Victor you’ve arrived.
nodes.zhText: 我得赶紧去市政厅，告诉维克多市长你到了。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds good. Thanks for everything
nodes.zhText: 听起来不错。谢谢你做的一切

nodes.speaker: Meriam
nodes.text: Enjoy your first day as a rancher! I’ll call soon to check in.
nodes.zhText: 祝你第一天当牧场主愉快！我很快会打电话问候你。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Talk soon!
nodes.zhText: 回头聊！

scenes.title: Contracts, tools and the workbench route
scenes.zhTitle: 合同、工具与工作台路线
scenes.summary: Victor's recorded contract conversation exposes separate electricity and water choices, each with a confirmation or defer branch.
scenes.zhSummary: 维克多的已记录合同对话分出电力与供水两个选择，每个选择都有办理或稍后再来的分支。
scenes.spoiler: Money and condition text below are build configuration. The site shows the branches but never evaluates or promises the result.
scenes.zhSpoiler: 下方金额和条件文字属于构建配置。网站只展示分支，不计算条件，也不承诺结果。

groups.label: Choose a contract, then confirm or defer
groups.zhLabel: 选择合同，再办理或暂缓
groups.overview: Conversation 8 keeps the option nodes and their destinations. The condition hints are editorial summaries, not evaluated checks.
groups.zhOverview: 对话 8 保留了选项节点及其去向。条件提示是编辑摘要，不是网站执行的判定。

nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: How i can help you today?
nodes.zhText: 今天我能帮你做些什么？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Subscribe to an electricity and gas contract
nodes.zhText: 办理电力和燃气合同

nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: Your energy use is billed at the end of each day. The commissioning fee is 1,000C. Would you like to subscribe now?
nodes.zhText: 你的能源使用会在每天结束时结算。合同启用费是 1,000C。现在办理吗？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Subscribe now
nodes.zhText: 现在办理
nodes.availabilityNote: Requires the build's money condition; not evaluated here.
nodes.zhAvailabilityNote: 需要满足构建中的金钱条件；网站不执行该条件。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll do it later
nodes.zhText: 以后办理

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Subscribe to a water contract
nodes.zhText: 办理供水合同

nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: Your water use is billed at the end of each day. The commissioning fee is 500C. Would you like to subscribe now?
nodes.zhText: 你的耗水量会在每天结束时结算。合同启用费是 500C。现在办理吗？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Subscribe now
nodes.zhText: 现在办理
nodes.availabilityNote: Requires the build's money condition; not evaluated here.
nodes.zhAvailabilityNote: 需要满足构建中的金钱条件；网站不执行该条件。

scenes.title: Chicken seller greeting and shop choice
scenes.zhTitle: 卖鸡商人的问候与商店选择
scenes.summary: Angela's recorded conversation confirms a first-meeting greeting and a shop menu with a shop-items option or a safe exit; it does not prove stock or purchase hand-off.
scenes.zhSummary: Angela 的已记录对话包含首次见面问候和商店菜单，可查看商品或退出；它不能证明库存或买鸡交接。
scenes.spoiler: The seller branch is configuration evidence only. Current stock, hours and the physical pickup route remain separate evidence.
scenes.zhSpoiler: 商人分支只是构建配置证据。当前库存、营业时间和实体取鸡路线仍需看其他证据。

groups.label: Greeting and shop menu
groups.overview: Conversation 46 keeps the first-meeting route and the two menu choices.
groups.zhOverview: 对话 46 保留首次见面路线和两个菜单选择。

nodes.speaker: Angela
nodes.text: You must be {PLAYER_NAME}! It's a pleasure to meet you! I'm {Talking_NPC_Name}, the poultry farmer and caretaker of this beautiful farm. My brother Malcolm mentioned you.
nodes.zhText: 你一定是{PLAYER_NAME}吧！很高兴见到你！我是{Talking_NPC_Name}，是这个美丽农场的家禽饲养员和看护人。我的兄弟马尔科姆提到过你。

nodes.speaker: Angela
nodes.text: Hi {PlayerName}!
nodes.zhText: 嗨，{PlayerName}！

nodes.speaker: Angela
nodes.text: How can I help you today?
nodes.zhText: 今天我能帮你做些什么呀？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: View shop items
nodes.zhText: 查看商店商品

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll come back later
nodes.zhText: 我晚点再来

scenes.title: Egg hand-off and the escape branch
scenes.summary: Gigi's recorded quest nodes branch on whether the player has two large eggs, then continue through the hand-off, police escape and return conversation.
scenes.zhSummary: Gigi 的已记录任务节点会根据玩家是否有两个大鸡蛋分支，然后继续到交付、逃离警察和送回后的对话。
scenes.spoiler: The egg check and later escape nodes are recorded build references. The site does not execute inventory or police conditions.
scenes.zhSpoiler: 鸡蛋检查和后续逃离节点是构建记录。网站不执行背包或警察条件。

groups.label: Two-egg check to the documented hand-off
groups.zhLabel: 两个鸡蛋检查到已记录交付
groups.overview: Conversation 51 keeps the choice node, the two-egg branch, the escape cue and the post-escape hand-off.
groups.zhOverview: 对话 51 保留选择节点、两个鸡蛋分支、逃离提示和逃离后的交付。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}! You made it. Do you have the eggs?
nodes.zhText: 嘿，{PLAYER_NAME}！你终于来了。你带鸡蛋了吗？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, 2 large eggs, both organic.
nodes.zhText: 是的，2 个大鸡蛋，都是有机的。
nodes.availabilityNote: The source condition requires at least two large eggs.
nodes.zhAvailabilityNote: 来源条件要求至少有两个大鸡蛋。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Working on it!
nodes.zhText: 正在弄呢！
nodes.availabilityNote: The source condition is fewer than two large eggs.
nodes.zhAvailabilityNote: 来源条件是少于两个大鸡蛋。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: Perfect. Thank you. This helps more than you know.
nodes.zhText: 太好了。谢谢你。这帮了我大忙，你都不知道。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: I have joined Vitalis Labs so I can run real tests. I want the truth in the open.
nodes.zhText: 我加入了维塔利斯实验室，这样就能做真正的测试。我想把真相公之于众。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really think it is that serious?
nodes.zhText: 你真觉得有那么严重吗？

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: Yes. We are seeing odd fractures in shells, strange hatch rates, and residue that does not belong in healthy feed cycles.
nodes.zhText: 是的。我们发现蛋壳有奇怪的裂纹，孵化率异常，还有在健康的饲料循环里不该出现的残留物。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: Do you hear that?
nodes.zhText: 你听到了吗？

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: They are close. Someone tipped them off about the handoff. WE HAVE TO RUN!
nodes.zhText: 他们离得很近。有人通风报信，告诉他们交接的事了。我们赶紧跑！

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: We made it, {PLAYER_NAME}. Clean drop. I think the drones peeled off.
nodes.zhText: {PlayerName}，我们成功了。我觉得无人机已经离开了。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: You good?
nodes.zhText: 你没事吧？

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am good. The eggs are intact.
nodes.zhText: 我没事，鸡蛋都好好的。
nodes.availabilityNote: The source condition checks for two large eggs; the hand-off action is not run by this site.
nodes.zhAvailabilityNote: 来源条件检查两个大鸡蛋；网站不执行交付动作。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: I will get these into the cold room, then start tests tonight.
nodes.zhText: 我会把这些放进冷藏室，今晚就开始测试。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happens next?
nodes.zhText: 接下来会怎么样？

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: If the results show non controlled edits or vectors that can leak into wild flocks, we will have proof.
nodes.zhText: 要是结果显示存在不受控制的基因编辑，或者有能渗透到野生鸟类中的载体，我们就有证据了。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: I just sent your thank you credit and a secure contact card.
nodes.zhText: 我刚给你发了感谢礼金和安全联系卡。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything you need from me?
nodes.zhText: 你还需要我做什么吗？

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: Keep your coop fully organic and log every feed and hatch.
nodes.zhText: 让你的鸡舍完全采用有机方式，记录每一次喂食和孵化情况。

nodes.speaker: Gigi
nodes.text: Thank you for today, {PLAYER_NAME}. You did more than drive. You protected the truth.
nodes.zhText: {PlayerName}，谢谢你今天帮忙。你不只是开车而已，你保护了真相。

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Call me when you have results
nodes.zhText: 有结果了给我打电话

knownFollowUp.label: After the documented police escape condition
knownFollowUp.zhLabel: 满足已记录的逃离警察条件后
